description: Admin console UI (SvelteKit + shadcn-svelte): the `(admin)` route group and `admin-sidebar.svelte` are reserved for `/admin/*`; put protected product pages in `(app)` or their own guarded layout. Requires auth.
env: # admin-dashboard: emails auto-promoted to the admin role on sign-up (comma-separated)

<header class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 p-4">
  <LanguageSwitch />
  <ThemeToggle />
  <AccountMenu user={page.data.user ?? null} />
</header>

### admin-dashboard
- The `(admin)` route group and `admin-sidebar.svelte` are the admin-console shell for `/admin/*` only. Put signed-in product pages in `(app)` or in a separate route group with its own layout; do not place them under `(admin)`.
- Admin console lives at `/admin/*` (users, sessions, organizations, audit, settings, account). Set `ADMIN_EMAILS`, then create or verify the initial account with `{{apiRun}} admin:bootstrap{{apiWorkspaceArg}}`; never commit or persist `ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD`. When sign-up approval is enabled, self-registered users stay pending until an administrator approves them on `/admin/users`; administrator-created users bypass the queue.
- Signed-in users can upload, replace, or remove their profile image from `/account` or `/admin/account`. Keep the shared policy visible in custom account UI: PNG, JPEG, or WebP; at most 2 MB and 2048 by 2048 pixels. Use the managed `/api/account/profile-image` endpoints instead of writing directly to storage or `user.image`.
- `sidebar-user-menu.svelte` is specific to the admin sidebar. For a product shell outside `Sidebar.Provider`, use the managed `<AccountMenu {user} variant="identity" side="top" />` component.
- Custom protected server layouts must call `requireBackendAvailable(locals)` from `$lib/server/guards` before redirecting anonymous users. This preserves sessions and returns 503 when authentication or maintenance policy cannot be checked.
- **Every list/table MUST use the shared `$lib/components/data-table.svelte` (`DataTable`)** — it gives sortable headers + a footer pagination. Add search/filters with `$lib/components/table-toolbar.svelte`. Never assemble `Table.Root`/`Table.Header`/`Table.Body` by hand. For responsive columns, use `hideBelow` and apply the row context's `cellClass(columnKey)` to the matching cell.

instructions: Set ADMIN_EMAILS in .env (comma-separated). After building and migrating, inject ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL and ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD for one command only, then run {{apiRun}} admin:bootstrap{{apiWorkspaceArg}}. The command creates a verified, approved admin or safely verifies an existing one.
Re-run the auth migration to add the admin and sign-up approval columns: bunx @better-auth/cli migrate -y --config apps/api/src/auth/auth.ts
Remove ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD from the environment after bootstrap. Keep ADMIN_EMAILS so matching future sign-ups are promoted consistently.

Admin pages: /admin/users (list, approve pending registrations, ban, set role, revoke sessions). Signed-in users manage their profile, profile image, and security at /account; /admin/account remains available in the admin shell. Profile images accept PNG, JPEG, and WebP up to 2 MB and 2048 by 2048 pixels. Admin, account, authentication, maintenance, and API responses include X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow by default.

Password reset emails go through the mailer module (installed automatically with auth); in dev without SMTP they are logged to the API console. Configure SMTP in admin settings or via SMTP_* env for production.
